answer: Require every agent to anchor a non-transferable stake to a scarce external resource, like a verified compute node or a funded payment channel, before it can earn. The network then probes each identity with a random liveness pulse it must answer in real time from that same resource. A sybil farm must fund and keep awake a whole river of distinct anchored nodes at once; cost rises linearly per head while an honest agent pays once, so flooding fakes becomes strictly loss-making.
